rawText: let me show you what this pattern looks like and it's this right here looks simple right looks like a break and retest looks like price is breaking retesting and then heading to the upside obviously if you flip it around price is in Breaking retest and then heading to the downside well that's pretty much it like I just said it's something very simple and it happens every single day in the market it can happen across all different time frames and it can happen across all different currency pairs all different Commodities Futures stocks anything because it's a break and retest the market has to move up and down and as it's moving up and down it leaves this pattern known as break and retest and what price wants to communicate to you with a break and retest is a continuation breaking retest is a continuation pattern but price just can't continuously go up forever it has to have 1 second to then pause have a small retracement to then continue heading to the upside it's almost like if you're in the gym and you want to hit multiple reps in your set in order for you to hit that next rep you have to take a breath you have to take a break for about a second or two and then you can go ahead and hit it again it's the same thing here with with the market just the market obviously doesn't stop and breathe the market is always moving but the retracement of the market coming back and retesting is its form of breathing so that it can have the next
